sources.entry: Zoraxy - General purpose HTTP reverse proxy and forwarding tool. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Go/Docker
Zoraxy | General-purpose HTTP reverse proxy and forwarding tool with a web UI

summary.one_liner: Zoraxy is a general-purpose HTTP reverse proxy and forwarding tool with a web UI, written in Go.
summary.what_it_does: Zoraxy runs as a single binary that acts as a reverse proxy for HTTP/HTTP2 traffic, with virtual directories, automatic WebSocket proxying, basic auth, alias hostnames, custom headers, and load balancing. It handles TLS/SSL, including ACME certificates with auto-renew, SNI and SAN certs, and DNS challenges for Let's Encrypt with listed DNS providers. It can filter traffic by country or IP (single IP, CIDR, or wildcard), and it includes TCP/UDP stream proxying and an integrated uptime monitor. Extra utilities include a web SSH terminal, CIDR converters, mDNS and IP/port scanners, Wake-on-LAN, and a plugin system. Management is done through a web interface, with a standalone single-admin mode or an external permission mode for use behind another auth proxy.
use_cases: Reverse proxy for homelab web services
Obtain and auto-renew Let's Encrypt certificates for sites
Route traffic to multiple backend servers with load balancing
Forward TCP or UDP streams to internal hosts
Restrict site access by country or IP address
Manage proxy routes from a web UI instead of editing config files
notable: Web UI for managing reverse proxy rules, certificates and access control
Automatic WebSocket proxying with no extra setup
Built-in ACME with DNS challenge support and auto-renew
Community forward-auth support for Authelia and Authentik, plus OAuth2 and reCAPTCHA
caveats: Web SSH supports Linux-based systems only
Loopback SSH connections are disabled by default and the no-auth mode is a security risk unless behind another auth layer
ACME integration and some features are community-maintained, and the README lists maintainer vacancies
